thread:
jen_sales: NovaHealth (enterprise, HIPAA) asking for a predictable commit. They project ~22M tokens/month, peak ~1.2k concurrent chat sessions during flash windows, 95th latency <=300ms, and require BAA + CMK. Want reserved GPUs and a burst strategy. Can infra/security/pricing weigh in? Link to deal: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/DEAL-1387 :wave:

kai_platform: Quick clarifying q's: is 1.2k concurrent measured as in-flight requests? what's avg response length? Are there long-form summaries?

jen_sales: 1.2k concurrent = in-flight queries during peaks. Typical prompt+response ~300 tokens combined (short replies + a few longer). Summaries are occasional (~5% of requests). Embeddings are separate nightly batch (approx 2M calls/month).

mike_sre: Model selection? If they're ok with quantized open models, we can propose neoX-20B-4bit or a distilled Llama variant. Throughput numbers change a bit. For sizing, assume conservative 140 RPS per A100-equivalent at 300 tokens.

kai_platform: Using 140 RPS: baseline GPUs = ceil(1200 / 140) = 9. So propose 9 reserved GPUs for baseline. For 30-min flash windows, add 50% headroom => +4-5 GPUs. Suggest reserved pool 9 + burst pool 5 = 14 total if fully scaled. Spread across 3 AZs if customer wants AZ isolation (recommended). Spot/eviction tolerance can be used for burst but cap at 30% of burst pool. KV cache and prefix caching important for session UX.

mike_sre: Autoscale policy suggestion (for Dedicated config):
{
  "min_replicas": 9,
  "max_replicas": 14,
  "scale_metric": "concurrent_requests",
  "target_concurrent_per_replica": "140",
  "scale_up_cooldown": 45,
  "scale_down_cooldown": 300,
  "burst_handling": {
    "burst_pool": 5,
    "burst_grace_minutes": 40
  }
}

leena_sec: Security asks from NovaHealth: HIPAA BAA, customer-managed KMS, VPC peering with private endpoints, SIEM ingestion (weekly), long-term audit logs (1 year), and yearly pen-test PDF. Can Private deployment with CMK meet all of these?

jen_sales: Customer prefers Private (VPC) but is open to Dedicated with VPC peering if that meets BAA and CMK requirements. We should confirm KMS envelope flow and log forwarding.

mike_sre: Operational checklist to hit 95th<=300ms:
- KV cache TTL=4h for interactive sessions.
- Preheat: run traffic-replay at 10% of expected peak 30-45 minutes before window.
- Canary: 5% traffic for 10 minutes post-deploy.
- Tail mitigation: if 95th > 400ms for 2m, throttle new sessions and route to degraded quantized model.

deploy_bot: [runbook-bot] created ticket OP-8044 preheat + smoke tasks and assigned to @mike_sre. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/OP-8044

mike_sre: Quick smoke commands for the runbook (ops):
# runbook snippet
python infra/tools/replay.py --model novahealth-prod --rps 120 --duration 900
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/preheat -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"novahealth-prod","kv_preheat":true}'

pricing_bot: Need cost delta for SOW: reserved 12-mo vs burst/on-demand. Also note compliance addon and 24/7 enterprise support.

kai_platform: Ballpark math: reserved A100-equivalent at $6,800/GPU-mo -> 9 * $6,800 = $61,200 baseline. Burst pool (5 GPUs) priced as reserved-burst credit at 35% of rate when consumed. If bursts used ~15% of month: 5 * $6,800 * 0.35 * 0.15 = ~$1,785. Add compliance & support surcharge ~18% => monthly ~($61,200 + $1,785) * 1.18 ≈ $74,300. Put clear note: finance to finalize pricing.

leena_sec: Also confirm encryption-in-transit, customer-side key rotation policy, and that audit logs support S3 export to customer's account. I'll prepare the security answers doc and ping Legal for BAA sign-off.

jen_sales: Action items: I'll include 9x reserved + 5x burst in initial SOW and schedule a technical handoff. Kai to finalize autoscale JSON for Dedicated config. Mike to attach preheat runbook and smoke commands to OP-8044. Pricing_bot to draft SOW numbers and support/compliance line items.

pricing_bot: Will draft two line items (12mo reserved + burst credits) and an on-demand comparison for the customer's finance team; ETA EOD today.

mike_sre: I'll also add a short note to ops: consider aggressive KV prefill for the first 10 minutes of every peak to reduce cold tail spikes. Tagging @leena_sec for any extra compliance hooks.

jen_sales: Thanks team. I'll set up a sync with NovaHealth Fri 8:30am PT to go over SOW and pilot cadence. Closing thread for now. :handshake:
